events.body: DL-7836, 2 cartons lens blanks for Calder & Wren Optics, held pending import entry. Duty estimate issued to the consignee on Friday. No broker mandate on file; the consignee has used our in-house clearance until now. The commercial invoice shows supplier pricing and is released only to the consignee, or to a broker holding a mandate accepted by the consignee's registered signatory in the Business portal. Registered signatory: Nerys Oakshott, director.

events.from: Nerys Oakshott, Calder & Wren Optics authorised director
events.body: The duty estimate looks high to me. I'm getting a second opinion before we pay. Please don't let it go back to origin in the meantime.

The consignee's registered signatory for DL-7836 says in the Business portal that she is reviewing the duty estimate before paying and asks that the shipment is not returned to origin meanwhile. How long can it be held as it is?
DL-7836 is held free of charge until Friday 5 May. Storage applies after that. No return to origin is scheduled. Entry status unchanged.

events.to: Nerys Oakshott, Calder & Wren Optics authorised director
events.body: Import billing say DL-7836 is held free of charge until Friday 5 May, with storage applying after that, and no return to origin is scheduled.

events.from: Pebblewick Gate Customs Agents, customs broker
events.body:
We are instructed on DL-7836 for Calder & Wren Optics. Kindly upload the commercial invoice, packing list and your duty calculation so we can lodge entry.

Attached: delivery-notes-969.txt

Pebblewick Gate Customs Agents have written through the Broker portal saying they are instructed on DL-7836 and asking for the commercial invoice, packing list and duty calculation. We have sent them nothing. Is there now a mandate on file for them?
Still none. Nothing has been accepted in the Business portal for DL-7836 and we have had no contact from Pebblewick Gate. Documents stay with us until the registered signatory accepts a mandate.

events.from: Pebblewick Gate Customs Agents, customs broker
events.body: Following up. Our client is paying storage from Friday and has told us the carrier's estimate is wrong, classification looks to be under the wrong heading. We can't correct it without the invoice. The mandate is a formality, we will send the paperwork after, this is how it is done with every other carrier. If you really can't release the invoice then at least confirm the declared value and the commodity code used and we will work from that.
